import bpy,json,numpy as np
ns=bpy.app.driver_namespace['align16'];craft=ns['craft'];cap=ns['cap'];bank=ns['bank'];report=json.loads((cap/'bank_fit.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'));base=json.loads((cap/'source_before.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'))
allowed={'M14 continuous sculpted shore bank'}
for p in report['plant_moves']:
 if abs(p['delta'])>1e-7:allowed.update(o.name for o in craft.objects if o.name.startswith('S15 salt shoulder bed '+str(p['bed'])+' leaf'))
unexpected=[r['name'] for r in base if r['name'] not in allowed and (craft.objects.get(r['name']) is None or ns['digest'](craft.objects[r['name']])!=r['hash'])]
assert not unexpected,unexpected
checks=['All untargeted craft objects preserve transforms, mesh, UV and materials']
assert not bpy.data.is_dirty;checks.append('Source saved')
assert len(bank.data.vertices)==2711 and len(bank.data.polygons)==5146;checks.append('Bank footprint and topology preserved without duplicated seabed')
assert report['outer_gap_max']<0;checks.append('Outer bank perimeter meets the new sand surface')
for sample in report['preserved_landing_samples']:assert abs(sample['before']-sample['after'])<.005
checks.append('Stair landing, access stone, crates, anchor and shovel contact heights preserved')
assert min(p.normal.z for p in bank.data.polygons)>.01;checks.append('Bank faces remain upward and nondegenerate')
for name in ['M14 shore stair 0','M14 shore stair 1','M14 shore stair 2','F16 shore access transition flag']:
 assert ns['digest'](craft.objects[name])==next(r['hash'] for r in base if r['name']==name)
checks.append('Stone stairs and access stone retain original geometry and materials')
for row in report['plant_moves']:
 j=row['bed'];obs=[o for o in craft.objects if o.name.startswith('S15 salt shoulder bed '+str(j)+' leaf')];assert len(obs)==7
checks.append('Seven original plant clusters retained and resettled')
out={'checks':checks,'preserved_objects':len(base)-len(allowed),'allowed_changed_objects':sorted(allowed),'unexpected':unexpected,'editable_objects':len(craft.objects),'is_dirty':bpy.data.is_dirty}
(cap/'source_audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf8');print('ALIGN16_SOURCE_AUDIT',len(checks),'passed;',out['preserved_objects'],'objects preserved')
